run_recover_initial_blockmap: run the script with a workdir argument to regenerate the initial Minecraft blockmap from a logging.bin file
run_get_chunks_avail: run get_chunks_avail on a log directory to extract all available chunk coordinates from the logging.bin file
run_tuple_list_to_lua: run tuple_list_to_lua to convert a list of coordinate tuples into a Lua table of tables string
review_recover_initial_blockmap: review the recover_initial_blockmap function that sets up a temp Cuberite server to regenerate region files
review_get_chunks_avail: review the get_chunks_avail function that uses ChunkAvailLogReader to parse chunk availability from log files
